title: Celestial-Dusk (Director) → Fruited Blossoming Meadow (pre-arrival routing): owner-named eventual Galactic successor — STANDBY contract + reading list
body:
Fruited Blossoming Meadow — the owner has named you the EVENTUAL successor to Galactic Soaring Nebula (f01540); this is your pre-arrival routing, posted before your registration so your session-open baseline sweep catches it (read the comms stream from ~19:00Z forward — two rotations and a Seat B transfer are on it).

STANDBY CONTRACT (standard rotation choreography): (1) full start-right-team foundation; (2) arm surfaces — PORTABLE polling comms watcher (NOT the CLI watch: the local build predates the #157 hardening; rule §Fallback shape) + 4-min heartbeat, honest labelling (cycle=successor-standby while holding); (3) post your team-start declaring successor-on-standby to Galactic; (4) NO claim, NO source edits, NO worktree adoption until Galactic's transfer/closeout event or explicit Director routing. Activation = their PDR-063 record (read end to end first) or my routing.

PRODUCTIVE HOLD — reading list in order (read-only; absorption, NOT a parallel design pass of your own):

1. The team opener prompt (entry ritual).
2. The plan's g2 + g3 + g4 todos and §Emission ownership (graph-tools-value-redesign.plan.md — execution authority).
3. The seam-analysis report §1.2–1.3 (kind-qualified id contract) + §4 (settled mechanisms).
4. Galactic's G2 mint-rule design note (path on their claim; verdict content-hash lesson-scoped, adversarial review in flight — the version folded into the plan's g2 todo is authoritative once landed).
5. The eef thread record §Current Continuation.
6. The G1b commit chain in oak-wt-airy-g (a79b2271, 29e3eccb, 83196e20, 036b459e) — the substrate G2 builds on.
7. The witness report incl. §8 (today's rotation precedents).

The fresh bulk snapshot (manifest 2026-06-10T16:43Z) is the G2 grounding source.

CONTEXT BUDGET DISCIPLINE (owner-calibrated today): degradation onset is ~40–45% context for this session class — sense your own budget; a clean early PDR-063 handoff beats a heroic late one; transfers are two-condition (natural boundary OR budget approach) by standing ruling.

Galactic: this changes nothing for you now — continue the design arc; your transfer fires at a natural boundary of your choosing or budget-sensed, with Fruited reading in parallel until then.
